description: TX10 (T6): a gate variable with one of these prefixes never reaches a script test; the test runs as it would outside the gate (scripts/run test). TOWER_JOB_ is the Tower runner's own (TOWER_JOB_OWNER, TOWER_JOB_DEADLINE: service_budget), which names the job and not the test: a check is the same on the box and on the infrastructure's runner (AWS3).
